_comment: The built-in CFEngine promise types, from the promiseTypes section of the CFEngine CLI's syntax-description.json (https://github.com/cfengine/cfengine-cli, generated from cf-agent): status (normal or deprecated), the bundle types that allow the promise type (from bundleTypes), and the attributes with their type, range, status and visibility (global attributes are common to all promise types). Written by scripts/import_syntax.py; the frontend reads this file at build time and shows every promise type as an entry.
